title: Exporter: retries/backoff + DLQ, per-sink delivery metrics, structured errors
author: Svetlana Petrenko
release_notes: Audit-log exporter now retries with bounded backoff and supports a dead-letter queue on non-retryable or exhausted-retry failures. Adds per-sink delivery metrics (success/fail/latency) and structured error reporting for easier SIEM/export troubleshooting.
description: Context: We’ve seen intermittent export failures (notably S3 sink) and long-tail delivery lag when downstream sinks return transient errors or throttle. Previously the exporter would either (a) aggressively retry without backoff (causing bursty load), (b) fail the batch with limited visibility into which sink failed, or (c) log unstructured errors that were hard to correlate with sink type and request/batch identifiers. This PR introduces bounded retry/backoff per sink, adds a dead-letter queue (DLQ) path for non-retryable failures or exhausted retries, and standardizes structured error reporting and per-sink metrics to support alerting and faster incident triage. Summary of changes: Add retry policy (exponential backoff + jitter) with a max elapsed time and max attempts per sink; Classify errors into retryable vs non-retryable (e.g., 4xx auth/config errors → non-retryable, 429/5xx/timeouts → retryable) with sink-specific overrides; Add DLQ writer interface and first implementation for S3-based DLQ (JSONL payloads + metadata) with optional local file fallback for dev; Add per-sink metrics: exporter_sink_deliveries_total{sink,outcome}, exporter_sink_delivery_latency_ms{sink}, exporter_sink_retries_total{sink,reason}, exporter_dlq_writes_total{sink}, exporter_dlq_write_failures_total{sink}; Add structured errors (type, sink, code, retryable, attempt, max_attempts, batch_id, org_id if present, event_count, first_event_id, last_event_id) and ensure we don’t log event payloads; Wire batch processing to continue other sinks even if one sink fails (configurable fail-fast=false default); Add configuration knobs: retry.max_attempts, retry.max_backoff_ms, retry.max_elapsed_ms, dlq.enabled, dlq.s3_bucket, dlq.s3_prefix, dlq.max_bytes_per_object; Update runbook notes in-repo (docs/) with suggested alert thresholds and how to replay DLQ objects. Operational notes: DLQ objects include only the exporter envelope + event ids + validation error summaries (no raw secrets/tokens). Payload redaction still happens upstream; exporter additionally truncates error messages to avoid accidental leakage from downstream SDKs. This is intended to be rolled out with dlq.enabled=true in staging first; production default is dlq.enabled=true but can be disabled via env if needed. Testing: Unit tests for retry classifier, backoff bounds, and DLQ writer; Integration-style tests using a fake sink that returns sequences (429→200, 500→500→200, 403) verifying retry counts, classification, and DLQ writes; Added metric assertions to ensure counters increment on expected paths. References: ENG-2488 (Exporter hardening), ENG-2489 (delivery metrics/SLO), SUP-5033 (customer report: intermittent S3 export failures).

feat: add RetryPolicy w/ bounded exp backoff + jitter
feat: implement DLQ writer and S3DLQWriter
feat: add per-sink metrics + retry/DLQ counters
test: add sink failure sequence tests + metric assertions

review_conversation: Rafael Mendes: Can we confirm we won’t block all exports if one sink is down? We had lag amplification in the incident when one sink kept failing. Also, what is the default retry envelope (attempts/time)? Svetlana Petrenko (author): Default is fail-fast=false so other sinks continue; we still mark the batch as partially failed and emit exporter_sink_deliveries_total{outcome="partial"} on the batch summary log. Retry defaults: max_attempts=7, max_elapsed_ms=120000, max_backoff_ms=10000. These are overrideable per sink via config. Miles Thornton: Metrics look good. Please add a histogram for delivery latency per sink; counters alone won’t show tail issues. Also include a label for outcome (success/failure/dlq). Svetlana Petrenko (author): Added exporter_sink_delivery_latency_ms histogram w/ sink label; outcome is represented in exporter_sink_deliveries_total and in structured logs. For latency we record on terminal outcome only to avoid double-counting retries; added exporter_sink_retries_total to capture retry volume. Nadia Rahman: Re: structured errors, ensure we never log event payloads or customer-provided webhook URLs. We should treat webhook endpoints as sensitive. Svetlana Petrenko (author): Good call—sanitized webhook config logging (host only, no path/query), and structured error includes sink type and a hashed endpoint identifier (sha256(host+path) truncated) for correlation without leakage. Added tests to ensure URL isn’t present in logs. Kevin Osei: DLQ payload: confirm no secrets/tokens. Also can we cap DLQ object size and avoid writing huge objects if a batch is large? Svetlana Petrenko (author): DLQ writer stores only metadata + event ids + error summaries. Added dlq.max_bytes_per_object (default 5MB) and chunking by event id list; if chunking still exceeds limit we write a final truncated object and emit exporter_dlq_write_failures_total with reason="size_limit". Allison Grant: Please align metric names with the broader telemetry standard: *_total for counters, use seconds for histograms if we can. Svetlana Petrenko (author): Renamed counters to *_total (already), and changed latency histogram to exporter_sink_delivery_latency_seconds. Updated dashboards downstream will be handled in observability-pack. Requested changes addressed: Add sink-specific override for retry classifier (webhook 408/425 treated as retryable), document replay steps for DLQ objects, ensure dispatcher continues other sinks by default, add histogram metric. Final approvals: Rafael Mendes approved; Miles Thornton approved; Nadia Rahman approved; Kevin Osei approved.
notes: Follow-up: coordinate with observability-pack to add/adjust Grafana panels for exporter_sink_delivery_latency_seconds and exporter_dlq_* metrics; add alerting suggestions to SRE runbook once we’ve observed baseline in staging for ~1 week.
